check_run_status: check the completion, launch, and assignment status of HITs for a given Mephisto task run ID
validate_commands: validate a list of worker commands against minimum interaction, keyword, and safety word criteria
backend_validation: run backend validation on turker interaction logs and soft-block workers who fail validation
check_mturk_qual_turkers: list all MTurk workers who hold a specific qualification type ID using AWS credentials
grant_qual_to_turker: grant a qualification to an MTurk worker by associating the qualification ID with the worker ID
